Subject: Path to live: MAP + canary proposal (post-signature)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for kicking off the handoff call last week — excited to get started. As promised, attached is our first draft of a mutual action plan (Bluepine_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) that meshes our internal milestones with the implementation workstreams we discussed (rollout, canary, migration, training).

Top-level asks from Bluepine:
- Tight canary window for the payments gateway (2 weeks) with daily health checks
- Training for 3 product teams (two 90-minute sessions + office hours)
- Migration cutoff: parallel run for 10 business days, then cutover weekend

Proposed dates (we can shift if needed):
- Start: 2025-07-07 — implementation sprint 0 (env prep, CI hooks)
- Canary: 2025-07-21 — 2025-08-04 (two-week canary with staged traffic)
- Migration: weekend of 2025-08-15 (parallel run 2025-08-04 — 2025-08-15)
- Training: two sessions 2025-07-28 and 2025-07-30; weekly office hours through Aug

Attachments: Bluepine_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (MAP with milestones), Training_schedule_draft.pdf, Canary-test-plan.md (outline).

Questions for Redwood:
1) Can you confirm a single point of contact for runbook changes during the canary?
2) Any blockers on our proposed migration weekend (licenses, infra windows)?
3) Can Redwood provide an ops escalation matrix (primary/secondary) for the canary window?

If you prefer, we can lock a short sync this week to iron dates.

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Lam
Senior Program Manager — Integrations
Bluepine Health

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear plan and attachments. Jon here (implementation lead). Quick confirmations and comments inline:

- POC for runbook changes: Jonas Weber (primary), Marissa Cole (secondary) — we'll lock an on-call rotation for the canary and publish the runbook to the shared Drive folder.
- Migration weekend: at first glance no license or infra blockers from Redwood's side, but I need a brief capacity check for the GPU pool we're allocating for a small staging reproduction during canary (I expect to have confirmation by Wednesday).
- Ops escalation matrix: we'll provide a 1-page matrix and an on-call Slack channel; will drop link into the MAP drive by EOD Wednesday.

Regarding the schedule: the proposed windows look good. Two suggested minor adjustments:
1) Move the first training to 2025-07-29 (gives us an extra day after the staging dress rehearsal).
2) Add a short canary smoke test on day 0 and daily regression runs with agreed acceptance criteria — I'll add a checklist into Canary-test-plan.md.

Can we lock a 30-minute sync Wed 2025-06-11 11:00 AM PT to finalize runbook owners and the training attendee list? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and include the training ops lead.

On attachments: got Bluepine_MAP_v1.2.xlsx and Canary-test-plan.md. I added a draft runbook (Runbook_initial.md) to the Drive.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Implementation Lead — Redwood Inference

Adding a few operational notes from the CS/onboarding perspective — copied Sophie and Michael so they see the changes we'll propose to the MAP: 

- Canary traffic ramp: recommend 10% / 40% / 75% / 100% over four days (subject to health checks). Include a rollback gate at each step with the owner indicated.
- Acceptance criteria: success rate >= 99.5% for critical flows (auth, payment tokenization, refund). We'll embed a token-level latency target too (p95 < 220ms) for the canary period.
- Training: we'll split sessions by role (devs / ops / product). Marissa to own the ops session and run office hours on Thursdays 11-12 PT during the canary.

Operational attachments I'm adding: Training_schedule_draft.pdf (updated with attendee names) and a short checklist I'll paste into the MAP.

Small ask: if Bluepine can confirm a staging dataset snapshot (PII redacted) by 2025-07-03, that will speed the staging rehearsal.
